title: Google DeepMind just mathematically verified key parts of Signal
gist: Google DeepMind used agentic AI via a new framework, AlphaProof Code, to formally verify key cryptographic guarantees of the Signal protocol in four weeks, rediscovering known historical vulnerabilities but finding no new ones. The open question is whether AI formal verification scales across software at a workable cost; Google won't disclose cost or commercial plans.

insights.claim: Google DeepMind used agentic AI with a new framework called AlphaProof Code to formally verify a number of the Signal protocol's key cryptographic guarantees in a four-week proof-of-concept project.
insights.speaker: WIRED
insights.so_what: DeepMind is establishing a capability lead in AI-automated formal verification for security.

insights.claim: AlphaProof Code found no new vulnerabilities in the analyzed parts of the Signal protocol, but correctly identified known, long-fixed vulnerabilities in older versions and showed those could not be formally verified.
insights.speaker: WIRED
insights.so_what: Validates the method's sensitivity; strengthens confidence in protocol used by Signal, Google Messages and WhatsApp.
